title: StoryLark presentation
description: The shape of a StoryLark library: how it is organised, what a content unit is called, and how the shell is arranged. Every key is optional — an absent key takes the core default, permanently, so a template written today keeps working on every future engine. Only `layout` and `nouns` are consumed by the engine today (contract v1, Phase 0); the remaining keys are the agreed v1 contract surface and are read once the presentation layer becomes runtime data.

contractVersion.description: Contract major version. The engine refuses a file whose major it does not support; see SUPPORTED_CONTRACT_VERSION in validate.mjs.

layout.description: Library shape. 'flat' — standalone units in one list, no collection level. 'series' — units grouped into collections.

nouns.description: What a content unit and its collection are called throughout the UI. No user-visible string hardcodes 'story' or 'book'.

collection.description: The grouping level's name ('book', 'series'), or null for a flat library.

items.description: Which navigation entries appear, and in what order.

labels.description: Optional per-item label override; defaults come from `nouns`.

sections.description: Presence in the list = shown; order = display order.

features.description: Where every new core feature lands. An open map on purpose: a feature core has not shipped yet is not an unknown key, and a feature a template predates simply takes the core default.
